title: Lost Knowledge
description: After completing The Gardener of Men, Neloth asks you to retrieve one of Hermaeus Mora's Black Books from a dungeon on Solstheim. Return the book to him for a gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Telvanni wizard residing in Tel Mithryn on Solstheim.
I study Hermaeus Mora's Black Books and seek copies of them.
I will reward anyone who retrieves Black Books for me and let them keep the original.

QUEST_START: I have sent the traveler to retrieve a Black Book from a dungeon on Solstheim.
BOOK_RETRIEVED: The traveler has found the Black Book and should return it to me.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have made a copy of the retrieved Black Book for my research and allowed the traveler to keep the original.
I paid the traveler gold for their service in retrieving the Black Book.
I consider this particular matter closed, though I may know of other Black Books still hidden on Solstheim.
I maintain that carrying the real Black Books is far too dangerous, which is why I only keep copies for myself.

beats.comment: Neloth offers the quest after The Gardener of Men is completed, asking you to retrieve a Black Book.
Player has retrieved the Black Book from the dungeon and the quest advances to the return stage.
Neloth makes a copy of the Black Book, rewards the player with gold, and the quest concludes.
